description:
Keep a repository's authored gate registry intact across registry edits, so one `jit gate define` does not strip its comments and reorder its gates.

## Background

`serialize_gate_registry` (`crates/jit/src/declarations/gates.rs:185`) sorts gates and emits no comments. `jit gate define` publishes through it (`crates/jit/src/commands/gate.rs:672`), as do two sites at `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:2201,2263`. This repository's `.jit/gates.toml` holds comment lines recording each gate's input-footprint reasoning, which declarations cannot express, so one registry edit deletes that reasoning and the file has two competing forms.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: An edit through `jit gate define` or `jit gate remove` leaves authored comments and the order of untouched gates byte-identical.
- [hard] REQ-02: The registry has one write path, and a test proves REQ-01 over a registry that holds comments.
title: Gate registry edits keep the authored file
